intro: India-specific cybersecurity job sources for Associate Security Engineer, Application Security Engineer, Product Security Engineer, and Security Analyst roles. Live boards refresh in real-time; company careers pages update daily.

live_boards.name: Naukri.com — Application Security Engineer
live_boards.notes: India's largest job board. Refresh daily. Use their alert feature for hourly notifications on this exact query.

live_boards.name: Naukri.com — Security Analyst
live_boards.notes: L1/L2 SOC + Info Sec Analyst roles across the country. Filter by location (Bangalore / Mumbai / Pune / Hyderabad / Gurugram).

live_boards.name: Naukri.com — Product Security Engineer
live_boards.notes: Product-side security roles at Indian product companies. Zoho, Freshworks, Postman, Razorpay type employers.

live_boards.name: Naukri.com — Associate Security Engineer
live_boards.notes: Entry-associate specific query — best filtered by experience 1-3 years to match your level.

live_boards.name: LinkedIn India — Application Security Engineer (last 24h)
live_boards.notes: Freshest listings only. Save this search and enable email alerts for daily digest.

live_boards.name: LinkedIn India — Product Security Engineer (last 7 days)
live_boards.notes: Weekly cadence for product security — smaller pool than AppSec so wider window is fine.

live_boards.name: LinkedIn India — Security Analyst (entry/associate)
live_boards.notes: Pre-filtered to entry + associate experience levels (f_E=2,3).

live_boards.name: Instahyre — Security (India)
live_boards.notes: Tech-focused Indian job platform. Curated roles at product companies + funded startups. Recruiters approach you.

live_boards.name: Cutshort — Cybersecurity (India)
live_boards.notes: Tech-focused Indian platform. Startups + scale-ups. Skill-matched recommendations. Complete your profile for best results.

live_boards.name: Wellfound — India Security
live_boards.notes: Formerly AngelList. Indian tech startup security roles. Equity-first comp. Direct-founder outreach possible on smaller companies.

live_boards.name: HackerRank Jobs — Security (India)
live_boards.notes: Technical assessments built into the flow. Product companies use HackerRank heavily for security screens.

live_boards.name: Indeed India — Cybersecurity (fresh 3 days)
live_boards.notes: Aggregator. Cross-references Naukri, LinkedIn, company sites. Fresh-only filter keeps the noise down.

live_boards.name: Foundit (formerly Monster India) — Security
live_boards.notes: Legacy job board with strong enterprise coverage. Big-4 + traditional IT services heavily post here.

live_boards.name: Shine.com — Cybersecurity
live_boards.notes: Supplementary board. Useful for tier-2 city roles (Ahmedabad, Chennai, Kolkata).

live_boards.name: Glassdoor India — Cybersecurity
live_boards.notes: Cross-reference for salary bands + Glassdoor reviews before applying. Use with Naukri, not instead of.

live_boards.name: Y Combinator Work List — India Security
live_boards.notes: YC portfolio companies with Indian offices. Small pool but high signal — early-career friendly, direct-founder access.

target_companies.name: TCS (Tata Consultancy Services)
target_companies.notes: India's largest IT services firm. High volume of L1/L2 SOC and consulting roles. Entry-associate friendly. TCS Xperience Programme for graduates.

target_companies.name: Infosys
target_companies.notes: Second-largest Indian IT firm. Strong cybersecurity practice. Global services delivery — often client-facing roles.

target_companies.name: Wipro
target_companies.notes: Wipro Cybersecurity Services (CRS) hires across L1-L3. Global delivery centres for major banking + FS clients.

target_companies.name: HCLTech
target_companies.notes: Large cybersecurity practice. Government + BFSI client base. Good for entry roles with training pathway.

target_companies.name: Tech Mahindra
target_companies.notes: Strong telecom + BFSI cybersecurity focus. Overlap with your Cubic Telecom telematics background.

target_companies.name: Accenture India
target_companies.notes: Massive cybersecurity practice. Structured graduate + lateral hiring. Client-facing consulting track.

target_companies.name: KPMG India — Cyber
target_companies.notes: Cyber Risk Services practice. Strong lateral hiring at associate level. Client-facing advisory.

target_companies.name: Deloitte India — Cyber Risk
target_companies.notes: Cyber & Strategic Risk practice hires actively. Analyst / Consultant / Senior Consultant ladder. India Delivery Centre for global clients.

target_companies.name: EY India — Cybersecurity
target_companies.notes: Cybersecurity + Privacy consulting. Structured lateral hiring at associate + senior associate.

target_companies.name: PwC India — Cyber & Privacy
target_companies.notes: Cyber + Privacy practice. Consulting career track.

target_companies.name: Cisco India
target_companies.notes: Bangalore is Cisco's second-largest R&D site. Product Security team includes AppSec + Talos threat intel.

target_companies.name: Microsoft India
target_companies.notes: Microsoft Defender + Sentinel + Purview teams in Hyderabad. Product security across Azure. Standard lateral entry.

target_companies.name: AWS India
target_companies.notes: AWS Security Engineer ladder (SDE-I equivalent for entry). High technical bar. Deep interview loop.

target_companies.name: Google India
target_companies.notes: Google India engineering hires security roles across product + infrastructure. Highly competitive.

target_companies.name: Adobe India
target_companies.notes: Strong Product Security team in India. Direct AppSec + secure code review roles.

target_companies.name: SAP Labs India
target_companies.notes: SAP's largest R&D centre outside Germany. Product security across HANA + Cloud.

target_companies.name: IBM India
target_companies.notes: IBM Security (QRadar, X-Force, Guardium) hiring in India. Consulting + product teams.

target_companies.name: Oracle India
target_companies.notes: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure security engineering. OCI is growing — good time to enter.

target_companies.name: VMware / Broadcom India
target_companies.notes: Post-Broadcom acquisition. Still a substantial security engineering base in Bangalore.

target_companies.name: CrowdStrike India
target_companies.notes: Overwatch managed SOC has India team. Threat intel + detection engineering. Entry-friendly via Overwatch pathway.

target_companies.name: Palo Alto Networks India
target_companies.notes: Unit 42 threat intel + product security in India. Interview process is rigorous but rewarding.

target_companies.name: Zscaler India
target_companies.notes: Cloud security specialist. Chandigarh is a large R&D site — often overlooked.

target_companies.name: Fortinet India
target_companies.notes: Firewall + SD-WAN + FortiGuard threat intel. Steady hiring at associate level.

target_companies.name: Trellix (formerly McAfee/FireEye) India
target_companies.notes: Post-merger consolidation. Big Bangalore engineering base for XDR + threat intel.

target_companies.name: Check Point India
target_companies.notes: Israeli firewall + threat prevention leader. Bangalore R&D hires steadily.

target_companies.name: Rapid7 India
target_companies.notes: InsightVM + InsightIDR + AppSec teams. Pune engineering centre. Good AppSec entry pathway.

target_companies.name: Razorpay
target_companies.notes: Indian fintech unicorn. Payment security context — RBI regulated. Strong AppSec team.

target_companies.name: Freshworks
target_companies.notes: SaaS product company (Nasdaq listed). Product security team hires AppSec + cloud security.

target_companies.name: Zoho
target_companies.notes: Bootstrapped SaaS giant. Product security across 45+ apps. Strong engineering culture, lower-key hiring.

target_companies.name: Postman
target_companies.notes: API tooling unicorn. Small but growing security team — high impact per engineer.

target_companies.name: Flipkart
target_companies.notes: Walmart-owned e-commerce leader. Large product security team. Payment + fraud security overlap.

target_companies.name: Payatu
target_companies.notes: Pune-based offensive security specialist. Hardware + IoT + web + mobile. Strong training culture — nullcon organisers.

target_companies.name: SAFE Security (formerly Lucideus)
target_companies.notes: Cyber risk quantification platform. Well-funded, high-profile Indian security startup.

target_companies.name: Astra Security
target_companies.notes: Continuous pentest platform. Remote-first Indian startup. AppSec + pentesting focus.

target_companies.name: CloudSEK
target_companies.notes: Attack surface + threat intelligence platform. Bangalore-headquartered. Active hiring.
